## Module intents

- **module:api** — internal/db owns schema lifecycle with a hand-rolled migration runner: SQL files are compiled into the binary via go:embed, applied in sorted lexicographic order, and each file is executed inside its own transaction that also records the filename in a _migrations ledger table for idempotency. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `api/internal/db/migrate.go:14`, `api/internal/db/migrate.go:19`, `api/internal/db/migrate.go:40`, `api/internal/db/migrate.go:52`, `api/internal/db/migrate.go:59`, `api/internal/db/migrate.go:78`
- **module:api** — `api` — no internal import edges (leaf or entry module); defines DB tables `api_tokens`, `audit_log`, `audit_logs`, `change_proposals`, `environment_versions` +6 more; reads 3 env vars. _(by cartographer-map; accepted by sol 2026-08-12)_ — cites `api/internal/db/migrations/0008_api_tokens.sql:2`
- **module:api** — internal/crypto implements envelope encryption for stored values: each Encrypt call generates a random 32-byte AES-256-GCM data key, wraps it with a process-global master key loaded from ENVY_MASTER_KEY_B64, and emits a versioned self-describing frame (version byte + key nonce + wrapped key + value nonce + ciphertext); the master key is held in a mutex-guarded package variable and must be initialized at startup or Encrypt/Decrypt return ErrNotInitialized. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:18`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:20`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:30`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:36`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:46`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:75`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:103`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:126`, `api/internal/crypto/envelope.go:138`
- **module:cli** — The CLI's local project state lives in a `.envy/` directory: `add` reads/writes `.envy/schema.json` with key validation (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`, <=64 chars) and typed defaults, while `diff` locates `.envy` by walking up parent directories and resolves the project/environment binding by probing several candidate JSON files and key paths. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/internal/cmd/add.go:94`, `cli/internal/cmd/add.go:17`, `cli/internal/cmd/add.go:137`, `cli/internal/cmd/add.go:147`, `cli/internal/cmd/diff.go:107`, `cli/internal/cmd/diff.go:127`, `cli/internal/cmd/diff.go:128`, `cli/internal/cmd/diff.go:60`

- **module:cli** — `cli/internal/api` owns the shared HTTP client abstraction for the ENVY backend: a `Client` struct holding BaseURL/Token/HTTP that builds `/projects/{slug}/environments/{name}` (and `/schema`) URLs, sets `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and converts non-2xx responses into errors — commands construct it via `api.NewClient(...)`. _(by cartographer-map-llm; accepted by sol 2026-08-13)_ — cites `cli/internal/api/client.go:15`, `cli/internal/api/client.go:22`, `cli/internal/api/client.go:60`, `cli/internal/api/client.go:68`, `cli/internal/api/client.go:82`, `cli/internal/api/client.go:114`, `cli/internal/cmd/approve.go:45`, `cli/internal/cmd/diff.go:70`
